headline: Savanna Fibre sets 2027 target of one million more homes as subscribers hit 250,000
summary: Savanna Fibre plans to extend its fibre network to 1 million more homes across Uganda, Tanzania and Kenya in 2027. The company says it has passed 250,000 active home internet subscribers in the three countries.
why: Savanna Fibre is a fibre broadband provider whose parent, Savanna Telecom (Africa), is based in Mauritius. Network expansion drives subscriber growth and capital spending for East African internet operators.
